law.catch_line: Possession and distribution of gamma-butyrolactone; 1, 4-butanediol; enhanced penalty
law.text: Any person who knowingly manufactures, sells, gives, distributes or possesses with the intent to distribute the substances gamma-butyrolactone; or 1, 4-butanediol, when intended for human consumption shall be guilty of a Class 3 felony.
